notes: Fixes a real bug: after you downloaded or updated your saved data, the app kept using the copy it already had in memory until you restarted it — so a re-download appeared to change nothing, and the 🔬 server check kept reporting the same stale differences. Downloads now take effect straight away. The 🔬 check also stops giving a score when this device hasn't got enough history loaded to judge fairly — it says so plainly instead. And when the check does find a share whose saved history has drifted, there's now a 🩹 Repair button that re-pulls just those shares rather than the whole market.
